name: 3D Deformable Object Grasping Benchmark
description: Evaluation suite assessing RL algorithms on grasping 3D deformable objects through simulated environments, tasks, and performance metrics.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (grasp success rate) / average episodic reward
reputation: A research-oriented benchmark used by papers exploring deformable-object manipulation; useful but not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Simulator- and scenario-specific (sim-to-real gap common). Small/heterogeneous task suite; performance depends strongly on simulator fidelity and object models; not an LLM benchmark.
